sources.role: Prediction-market contract metadata, rules, quotes, trades, candles, and order books.
sources.provider: Kalshi Trade API v2 at Alay-selected https://api.elections.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2
endpoints_or_identifiers: KXHIGHNY series / market tickers; market and event tickers
Market metadata, historical markets/trades/candlesticks, and orderbook endpoints; confirm the exact pilot routes
sources.documented_coverage: Kalshi’s current market-data quick-start documents unauthenticated public market data at https://external-api.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2 and illustrates series, markets, and orderbooks; it says the base serves all market categories. The requested api.elections.kalshi.com host is not the base shown in that current quick-start, so verify it remains supported and equivalent with a permitted pilot request. Historical endpoints and selected-pilot quote/depth coverage still require a sample check.
sources.cadence: REST snapshots or documented WebSocket market feeds; proposed sampling cadence is not yet approved.
sources.retention_or_limits: Live/history tier handoff; API rate limits may change without notice. No guaranteed historical depth window established for these pilots.
sources.usage_terms: The Developer Agreement currently limits API use to facilitating the member's own trading and prohibits collecting, caching, aggregating, or storing API data except for that purpose, and sharing it without prior written authorization. The separate website data terms also restrict collection and redistribution. This research/dashboard use must not assume public API access grants archive or display rights.
material_gaps: Written authorization or an expressly licensed archive is needed before project capture/storage/sharing.
Exact history, settlement-rule versions, historical quote depth, and fee schedule need pilot-level verification.
The weather pilot's binding rule names The Weather Company; Kalshi metadata alone does not supply its independent resolution series.
sources.next_verification: Adele and Carlos: verify the requested api.elections.kalshi.com base against Kalshi’s currently documented external-api base on a permitted pilot; confirm exact routes, history, settlement identifiers, and rights. Obtain written permission or an expressly licensed alternative before collection.
sources.proposed_capture_start: 2026-11-18 only after written authorization or an approved licensed source covers research, storage, sharing, and intended dashboard display; otherwise do not collect.

sources.role: Market discovery, contract/resolution metadata, token IDs, price histories, current books, and trades for matched or threshold contracts.
sources.provider: Polymarket CLOB API (primary, per Alay); Polymarket Data API v2 only for its documented historical price-history route if needed; Gamma only for market/token metadata and rules discovery.
endpoints_or_identifiers: condition_id / market_id and outcome token_id (or position_id for Protocol V2 markets)
CLOB REST orderbook and last-trade-price endpoints; CLOB real-time market feed
Officially documented price history: https://data-api.polymarket.com/v2/prices-history (record endpoint/version and returned resolution_seconds)
sources.documented_coverage: The CLOB provides outcome-token books and last-trade prices. Polymarket’s current documentation routes bucketed historical price queries through Data API v2; explicit start/end ranges are limited to 15 days, full history defaults to 12-hour buckets, and finer history windows vary by resolution. Verify coverage for the pilot token and distinguish price history from historical executable depth.
sources.cadence: CLOB snapshots or WebSocket updates for current books and trades; historical price points are bucketed through the separately documented Data API v2 route. Pilot sampling cadence is not set.
sources.retention_or_limits: Fine-resolution history decays; exact availability can vary by endpoint and token. No official archived historical full-depth book range established.
sources.usage_terms: The current Terms of Use restrict some data use by capital-market clients and market-data distributors and restrict redistribution/commercial exploitation absent a written agreement. The intended retail analytics dashboard may implicate these definitions; classification and rights must be confirmed before collecting or displaying data. Public endpoints do not themselves establish downstream display rights.
material_gaps: Written terms for the team's research archive and dashboard display need confirmation.
Exact matched contract rule equivalence, point-in-time history, and settlement outcomes need a pilot sample.
Current API price history does not establish historical bid/ask depth or executable size.
sources.next_verification: Adele and Alay: confirm exact IDs and resolution sources; use CLOB as the primary live source, confirm whether the Data API v2 history route is acceptable for historical prices, and verify returned dates/resolution on a permitted sample. Confirm rights for research archive and retail-dashboard display before collecting.
sources.proposed_capture_start: 2026-11-18 only after written authorization or an approved licensed source covers research, storage, sharing, and intended dashboard display; otherwise do not collect.

Public docs do not establish exact coverage dates, completeness for the selected markets, sampling, or historical depth quality; verify with a permitted sample and inspect timestamps and gaps.
sources.cadence: API access and tick-history downloads; account-specific quotas, billing, cadence, and retention/availability need confirmation.
sources.retention_or_limits: Public documentation advertises historical orderbook tick data. Exact Kalshi history window, granularity, request/download limits, and record completeness for the pilot are unverified.

No sample has established exact pilot identifiers, history dates, granularity, missingness, update latency, or cost.
Predexon data must not be assumed equivalent to direct Kalshi responses; retain source/provider and retrieval timestamp in provenance.
sources.next_verification: Carlos and Adele: request/inspect a permitted sample for the exact pilot markets, compare timestamps, coverage, and book fields with direct Kalshi data, confirm plan/cost and license rights for archive/dashboard use, and keep collection blocked until rights are clear.
sources.proposed_capture_start: After sample validation and written authorization covering research, storage, sharing, and intended dashboard display; otherwise do not collect.

sources.role: Deterministic hourly forecast and location/grid metadata for weather-market comparison.
sources.documented_coverage: The point API returns current forecast URLs; hourly forecasts cover the next seven days. The API removes past forecast periods, so it is not a vintage forecast archive.
sources.cadence: Capture each selected issue/vintage and record fetched_at, issuedAt, valid period, grid, and source URL; suggested daily or per-run capture to confirm with Carlos.
sources.retention_or_limits: Rolling forecast content expires with its information lifecycle. Reasonable rate limits apply but the numeric limit is not public; the request User-Agent is required.
sources.usage_terms: NWS states API data are intended as open data, free for any purpose, subject to reasonable rate limits. Verify attribution and applicable dataset-specific terms before public presentation.
material_gaps: No historical forecast archive from the live endpoint; prior vintages must be captured prospectively or sourced elsewhere.
Market location/station and local-day window may not match a nearby grid forecast.
sources.next_verification: Carlos: confirm NWS is retained as a benchmark, choose coordinates/grid and forecast issue cadence, and confirm local-hour matching against each market's settlement rule.
sources.proposed_capture_start: 2026-11-16 for rolling forecast vintages, subject to Carlos confirming this is a benchmark; this inventory does not start a collector.

sources.role: Ensemble members for the existing weather pilot's NCEP GEFS, ECMWF IFS, and DWD ICON comparison.
sources.provider: Open-Meteo Ensemble API (underlying model systems include NCEP, ECMWF, and DWD)
endpoints_or_identifiers: latitude/longitude, model run, member, issued/valid time
sources.documented_coverage: The current Ensemble API offers individual members, three days of historical data, and forecasts normally for seven days (up to 36 days for supported models). For longer fixed-lead validation, the Previous Runs API has model-specific archive starts; exact model coverage must be checked before use.
sources.cadence: Live model updates; model issuance varies. Capture run/issue time, member, lead time, and valid time for each snapshot.
sources.retention_or_limits: Free API limits and permitted use depend on plan; do not assume the live free endpoint is suitable for a public/commercial dashboard.
sources.usage_terms: Open-Meteo's free API is restricted to non-commercial use and carries CC BY 4.0 attribution conditions. The dashboard's intended audience/use must be classified; use an appropriate commercial subscription/license if required. Underlying model source licenses may also apply.
material_gaps: The current weather pilot stores ensemble data; verify retention and terms before extending that archive or publishing it.
Three-day history is insufficient for a long retrospective test; validate exact Previous Runs coverage for the chosen model versions and lead times.
The market settlement source is not Open-Meteo; a forecast/model match does not replace resolution outcomes.
sources.next_verification: Carlos: approve model sources, lead times, and attribution; verify model-specific historical forecast coverage and choose the free/non-commercial or licensed service tier.
sources.proposed_capture_start: 2026-11-16 only after use classification and required license are confirmed; preserve forecast run metadata.

sources.role: Probabilistic station bulletin used in the existing pilot as a separate benchmark.
sources.provider: NOAA National Blend of Models (NBM) public S3 products / text archives
endpoints_or_identifiers: run cycle and target valid period
sources.documented_coverage: Operational NBM products and text bulletins are available; NOAA points users to a daily NBM archive for archived operational data. The existing pilot fetches the 01Z station bulletin. Exact archive start and retention of the text product need a sample/coverage check.
sources.cadence: NBM runs hourly; the pilot used a 01Z bulletin. Record run/issue cycle, station, fields, and target valid period.
sources.retention_or_limits: Public operational files may be transient; exact current S3 retention and backfill availability for the selected product are not guaranteed by the reviewed page.
sources.usage_terms: No product-specific reuse or redistribution terms were established from the reviewed archive page. Confirm current NOAA/NBM terms and attribution before building an archive or displaying the bulletin-derived series.
material_gaps: KNYC is near, but not the contract's binding CLINYC/The Weather Company resolution source.
NBM rounded summaries do not directly give exact contract-bin probabilities; the current pilot reconstructs approximate values.
Long historical forecast vintages and exact file retention are unverified.
sources.next_verification: Carlos: confirm the NBM product and station mapping, obtain exact archive coverage for selected dates, and assess bulletin/derived-data use terms.
sources.proposed_capture_start: 2026-11-16 for selected NBM vintages after source and use review; this inventory does not start a collector.

sources.role: Historical station observations for independent outcome checks and station metadata; not a substitute for the contract's named settlement source.
sources.provider: NOAA/NCEI Climate Data Online (CDO), including GHCN-Daily where available
endpoints_or_identifiers: Historical Observing Metadata Repository for station history
sources.documented_coverage: CDO provides historical daily/monthly station data; GHCN-Daily includes long station records with coverage varying by station and element. The existing pilot's exact settlement outcome is The Weather Company, so NCEI is only a validation/reference candidate unless rules are changed.
sources.cadence: CDO GHCN-Daily updates daily where possible; the API requires a token and permits up to five requests/second and 10,000/day.
sources.retention_or_limits: Historical record by station/element; latest station metadata reflects current location while HOMR carries historical station metadata. Verify station and final-QC availability for each event.
sources.usage_terms: CDO access is free. Dataset documentation notes WMO restrictions may apply to some non-U.S. data and commercial re-export; pilot scope is U.S. Central Park, but verify terms for the chosen dataset and any public redistribution.
material_gaps: NCEI observations do not establish the actual The Weather Company value named in the Kalshi resolution rules.
Station/day completeness, quality flags, and finalization lag vary; match the exact event window and temperature conversion/rounding.
sources.next_verification: Carlos: confirm whether NCEI is only a robustness benchmark; select exact station/dataset and test coverage for pilot days against contract rules.
sources.proposed_capture_start: Historical backfill can be queried after station and dataset are selected; no extra prospective outcome capture is proposed.
